headline: Profit surges on MLCC pricing recovery and optics demand
summary_short: Chaozhou Three-Circle's H1 2026 preliminary net profit is guided to ¥1.79B–¥2.04B, up 45%–65% y/y, while Q2 standalone EPS of ¥0.60 rose about 46% q/q and 62% y/y.
summary_long: H1 2026 net profit attributable is preliminarily guided to ¥1.79B–¥2.04B (+45% to +65% y/y); ex-non-recurring profit ¥1.65B–¥1.92B (+55% to +80% y/y). Q2 EPS of ¥0.60 rose ~46% q/q and ~62% y/y. Company attributes the jump to MLCC price recovery on improved customer recognition and industry conditions (volume and sales both up sharply), plus accelerating global data-center construction lifting demand for its optical ferrule/sleeve products. Figures are the company's own preliminary, unaudited forecast — the final half-year report was not located within budget.
confidence_notes: No edgarCik; shard sourceLink is a Yahoo fallback. Two WebSearch queries (Chinese) surfaced only the company's SZSE-mandated preliminary earnings forecast (业绩预告, published 2026-07-21) — a regulatory pre-disclosure ahead of the full half-year report — never the final audited report itself. One WebFetch of the jrj.com.cn republish of that forecast (non-aggregator financial-news portal) yielded the exact ranges and verbatim driver quotes used here. All net-profit figures are the company's own preliminary ranges, explicitly labeled unaudited by the disclosure; EPS row is the Q2-standalone actual from resolve-earnings-target.mjs's shard KPIs (Yahoo earningsChart) and is not on the same cumulative basis as the H1 profit range.

drivers.explanation: MLCC products benefited from improved customer recognition and industry conditions; prices on some specs were restored to fair value, lifting volume and sales substantially y/y.
Accelerating global data-center construction increased demand for optical components; the company's ferrule and sleeve optical-communication products grew sales y/y as a result.
